overview.summary:
This module implements the HTTP API surface for a service named "Zi" using FastAPI. It defines an application instance and a set of async endpoint handlers to manage audio generation jobs, release artifacts, package downloads, and a simple bot queue. Configuration and feature toggles are driven by environment variables (API tokens, allowed CORS origins, admin token and whether the bot is enabled). The module also includes request/validation models implemented with Pydantic for generation requests, release creation, submission marking, and brief bot payloads.

Endpoints cover lifecycle operations for generation jobs (create and retrieve), serving generated audio files, validating and creating releases, listing and retrieving release metadata, downloading packaged releases, marking submissions, and enqueuing or inspecting the bot queue. Administrative protection is provided by a require_admin dependency, and the application registers a lifespan hook for startup/shutdown behavior. External utilities and HTTP requests are supported via imports such as httpx, shutil and a local bot module.

overview.summary:
This module provides utilities for preparing audio and cover art assets for distribution. It includes asynchronous download support, ffmpeg-based audio processing and probing, sample-rate conversion tailored for a specific distributor, and an assembler that stitches together segments with crossfades and produces both a high-quality FLAC master and an MP3 preview. In addition, the module can generate original procedural cover art as a high-resolution JPG using Pillow, with text-light design suitable for store requirements.

The functions coordinate external tools and libraries: network fetching via an async download function, subprocess-driven ffmpeg invocations for resampling, normalization, duration probing and mixing, and Pillow routines to render 3000x3000 RGB artwork. Helper utilities encapsulate running shell commands and extracting segment durations to drive the stitching workflow.

overview.summary:
This module coordinates an audio generation and packaging pipeline that produces multi-section musical pieces, stitches segments into a single master of at least 180 seconds, performs licence and model-spec checks, and prepares a RouteNote-compatible release package. It reads configuration and model presets from environment variables, divides target duration into segments, creates generation predictions against an external API (Replicate), polls and finalizes jobs, and assembles generated media and metadata into a release artifact using local media and storage helpers and connector metadata mappings.

The pipeline exposes a set of async operations for creating and waiting on generation jobs, finalizing results, and building the final release, as well as synchronous helpers for calculating segment counts and a public entry point to start generation. It integrates with external services via httpx and uses filesystem work directories, temporary storage, and utilities like uuid and shutil to manage artifacts during processing, while enforcing minimum track length and licence awareness based on model configuration.

overview.summary: This single-file HTML document implements a dark-themed, responsive web interface for monitoring recent activity and live telemetry related to an operations snapshot and an AI MusicGen Studio. It includes a top header that displays the application title, workspace user ID, and snapshot meta information, along with navigation links for "Operations" and "AI MusicGen Studio." The page contains a dashboard-style layout with KPI tiles (e.g., active stream events), a live telemetry feed area, and a studio panel styled with custom CSS and Tailwind utility classes. Visual styling is provided by Tailwind via a CDN plus an embedded stylesheet that defines colors, layout rules, and animations such as a pulsing live-dot indicator.
